title: malus sylvestris subsp. acerba
intro: Malus sylvestris subsp. acerba, commonly known as wild crabapple, is a subspecies of the wild apple tree native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Malus sylvestris subsp. acerba include its astringent and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
